title: Draft start
description: On stdout: a POST /author accepted, before any agent runs: how many course files and guide files it sent. Never the prompt, a path or a file.

kind.description: The program (or, for the bridge, the message type) that printed the line.

run.description: One id per invocation (for the bridge, per process), on every line it prints: a random (version 4) UUID.

at.description: When the line was printed, UTC.

files.description: How many files the request sent under course/.

guide_files.description: How many files the request sent under guide/.
